name: msdoc_read_excel_sheet
description:
Reads cell values (computed, not formulas) from one worksheet of an Excel workbook (.xlsx/.xlsm), chosen by name or index. Files are looked up by name in the docs folder (data/msdocs; msdoc_list_files shows it).
Returns {filename, sheet_name, data, row_count, column_count}: data is a list of rows of cell values.
Inputs (* required): filename*, sheet_name (wins over sheet_index), sheet_index (0-based), max_rows (1-10000; default 100). Without either the active sheet is read.
For formulas use msdoc_read_excel; for sheet names msdoc_get_excel_sheets.
Example: {"filename": "sales.xlsx", "sheet_index": 1, "max_rows": 200}

sheet_name.description: Name of the sheet to read

sheet_index.description: 0-based index of the sheet to read

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return
